title: The Reduction Theorem for Leavitt Labelled Path Algebras and Its Applications
summary: We introduce a notion of labelled cycle for normal labelled spaces and prove a reduction theorem for Leavitt labelled path algebras. We show that every nonzero element can be reduced, by suitable left and right multiplication, either to a nonzero scalar multiple of a projection or to a polynomial supported on a labelled cycle without exits. This extends the classical reduction theorem for Leavitt path algebras of directed graphs and its analogues for ultragraph Leavitt path algebras and subshift algebras.
